parrafo.es: LRU Landscaping renueva cesped, instala camas de mulch y plantas, y construye caminos y patios en piedra en Palm Beach County. Sus clientes en Google destacan a Ken y su equipo por comunicar bien, llegar a tiempo y dejar el patio transformado de verdad.
parrafo.en: LRU Landscaping renews lawns, installs mulch beds and plants, and builds paver walkways and patios around Palm Beach County. Their Google reviewers point to Ken and his crew communicating well, showing up on time and leaving the yard truly transformed.

parrafo_1.es: LRU Landscaping, liderado por Ken, atiende renovaciones de cesped, camas de mulch y plantas, y proyectos de hardscape en Palm Beach County.
parrafo_1.en: LRU Landscaping, led by Ken, handles lawn renovations, mulch and plant beds, and hardscape projects around Palm Beach County.

parrafo_2.es: Sus clientes en Google cuentan como su equipo retiro rocas y tierra vieja, puso cesped y plantas nuevas, y comunico cada paso con claridad. Mas de un cliente dice que ya recomendo a Ken a sus vecinos.
parrafo_2.en: Their Google reviewers describe a crew that removed old rocks and dirt, laid down fresh sod and plants, and communicated every step clearly. More than one client says they already gave Ken's name to their neighbors.

texto.es: Nos cuentas lo que quieres lograr en tu patio y coordinamos una visita.
texto.en: Tell us what you want for your yard and we will set up a visit.

texto.es: Ken revisa el terreno en persona y te da una propuesta flexible segun tu proyecto.
texto.en: Ken reviews the property in person and gives you a flexible proposal for your project.

texto.es: El equipo llega, retira lo viejo si hace falta y pone cesped, plantas o piedra con cuidado.
texto.en: The crew arrives, clears out the old material if needed, and installs sod, plants or stone with care.

texto.es: Revisamos el resultado contigo antes de dar el trabajo por terminado.
texto.en: We walk the finished yard with you before calling the job done.

nota.es: Cada proyecto se cotiza segun el patio. Llamanos y te damos el detalle.
nota.en: Every project is quoted based on the yard. Call us and we will walk you through it.

texto.es: Retiro de cesped, rocas o tierra vieja e instalacion de cesped nuevo.
texto.en: Removal of old lawn, rocks or dirt and installation of fresh sod.

texto.es: Diseno e instalacion de camas de mulch, arbustos y plantas que dan color todo el ano.
texto.en: Design and installation of mulch beds, shrubs and plants that keep color year round.

texto.es: Caminos de piedra, patios en pavers y areas de piso duro hechas a medida.
texto.en: Stone walkways, paver patios and hardscape areas built to fit your property.

texto.es: Luces de camino y acento que resaltan el trabajo terminado de dia y de noche.
texto.en: Pathway and accent lighting that shows off the finished work day and night.

pie.es: No ves lo que buscas? Llamanos igual, lo cotizamos.
pie.en: Do not see what you need? Call us anyway and we will quote it.

items.quote: I couldn't be happier with my new front lawn. The team removed all the old rocks and dirt and laid down fresh sod, mulch, and beautiful plants. Ken was fantastic to work with & very communicative, punctual, and clear every step of the way.

Ken and his team did an amazing job with our front yard recently. After meeting with multiple landscapers, I immediately decided to work with Ken due to his professionalism and trustworthiness. I will be using Ken for all future landscaping needs.
I can't say enough about how amazing the transformation was on our lawn!! Ken was professional, responsive and communicated perfectly!! Would definitely recommend and rehire!!!
